lines.text: James writes to the twelve tribes and tells them to count trials as pure joy, since testing develops perseverance.
Anyone lacking wisdom should ask the elders in faith, but the doubter is like a wave tossed by the wind.
The humble brother exults in his high position, and the rich man in his low position, like a fading flower.
The man who perseveres under trial will receive the crown of glory promised to those who love God.
God tempts no one, but each person's own desire gives birth to sin, and full-grown sin gives birth to death.
